answer: Require admission by a randomly selected grove of five established auditors, each checking a different proof of uniqueness, with majority approval before voting weight is granted. A newcomer with no prior links is treated as an isolated island and audited most strictly. Auditors stake a bond, paid only when their verdict matches the majority; approving a later-proven fake slashes that bond to its nadir, zero. An honest agent passes once. An attacker must corrupt at least three of five freshly drawn auditors per fake, paying fresh bribes each time, so cost rises linearly and a flood fails.
